summary: Using Pick Block on boats crashes the game
description: I know that this is duplicated with but MAY I help you tell the reason? Description 1. Place a boat, any variant. 2. Switch to creative mode. 3. Middle-click the boat, and you ll find that it crashes. Reason "class cqh" (Boat) has a function "cvx cqh.dK()" (Boat.getPickResult). That returns a new "class cvx"(ItemStack) of function "cvt cqh.al_()" (Boat.getDropItem). "cvt cqh.al_()" (Boat.getDropItem) returns "cqh$b cqh.w()" (Boat.getVariant) s "cvt cqh$b.d()" (Boat$Type.getBoat) . And it seemed like "cvt cqh$b.d()" returns null, then "cvx. (deu, int, ku)" (ItemStack(ItemLike, int, PatchedDataComponentMap)) crashes.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Place a boat of any variant in the world.
2. Switch to Creative mode.
3. Middle-click on the placed boat.
4. Observe that the game crashes after middle-clicking the boat.
Observed Behavior: When using the pick block function on a boat in Minecraft, the game crashes under specific conditions. To reproduce this issue, first place any variant of a boat. Then, switch to creative mode and middle-click on the boat. This action triggers the crash. The root cause lies within the "class cqh" (Boat) which contains the function "cvx cqh.dK()" (Boat.getPickResult). This function generates an ItemStack by calling "cvt cqh.al_()" (Boat.getDropItem), which in turn retrieves the boat variant through "cqh$b cqh.w()" (Boat.getVariant) and then calls "cvt cqh$b.d()" (Boat$Type.getBoat). The issue arises when this function returns null, causing the creation of an ItemStack to fail and subsequently crash the game with "cvx. (deu, int, ku)" (ItemStack(ItemLike, int, PatchedDataComponentMap)). This sequence of events highlights a critical flaw in how boat variants are handled during pick block operations.
Expected Behavior: When middle-clicking (using Pick Block) on a boat in creative mode, the game should successfully pick up the boat and add it to the player’s inventory without crashing. This action should work consistently for all types of boats, including wooden and minecart variants, ensuring that the game remains stable and functional.
